statements.t: We are focusing the riboswitch platform on the regulated in vivo delivery of metabolic peptides, including leptin, GLP-1, GIP, glucagon, amylin and PYY, as well as cell therapy, CAR-T for liquid and solid tumors and autoimmune diseases, and additionally, PNS targets addressing long-term intractable pain.
